title: Indian Style German Pancakes
description: A twist on traditional German pancakes, this recipe adds an Indian flair with the use of toasted spices and tender yogurt.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the flour, yeast, and sugar.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the warm milk, egg, and melted butter.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Add the yogurt, cinnamon, and cardamom (if using) to the batter and mix until well combined.
Heat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat.
Drop the batter by 1/4 cupfuls onto the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes, until bubbles appear on the surface.
Flip the pancakes and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until golden brown.
Serve the pancakes warm with your favorite toppings, such as maple syrup, fresh fruit, or whipped cream.
